_about: The bodies build.py can make. 'like' takes another entry and changes what is named. '_base' holds the settings and is not built itself; 'momentum-body' is the body the app ships (the owner's choice at the gate of block 7A: the athletic type with head A), installed to public/models/ with --install. 'gate-2' is that body with the two corrections the owner added after the gate — a surface without folds, and shorter, stronger arms held closer — shown on the second sheet and not installed: production follows his word. 'gate-2-b' is the same with the relief bounded at 6 mm instead of 4: more drawing, and a trace of the fold at the waist — the sheet's alternative.
